items.name: Energy Saver Settings Report
items.description: Extracts Energy Saver subgroup values from current scheme for review and tuning.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"; $f=Join-Path (Join-Path $PWD "logs") ("energy-saver-"+$ts+".txt"); powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_ENERGYSAVER | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $f; Write-Output "Saved: $f"
